  409.3-307.  Waiver and modification. — The commissioner may waive or modify, in whole or in part, any or all of the requirements of sections 409.3-302, 409.3-303, and 409.3-304(b) or the requirement of any information or record in a registration statement or in a periodic report filed pursuant to section 409.3-305(i).

­­--------

(L. 2003 H.B. 380)

Effective 9-01-03, see § 409.7-701
